title: Autopatch enrolled while custom update rings still target devices

report.title: {Items.Count} custom update {Plural(Items.Count, 'ring still targets', 'rings still target')} devices while Autopatch is enrolled

messages.businessImpact: Two patching control planes reach the estate at once. Devices can sit in a hand-built ring and an Autopatch ring, so deadlines and deferrals disagree and nobody owns the outcome.
remediation: Retire or unassign custom rings Autopatch has replaced, or exclude those device groups from Autopatch until the cut-over is finished.
messages.cannotSee: Autopatch ownership is inferred from ring names (IsAutopatchManaged). A renamed Autopatch ring reads as custom. Whether the custom ring and an Autopatch ring actually overlap on devices is UPD-003 and UPD-024 territory.
